underground

lane

inhabitant

parking

live

frequent

take time

decent

get rid of sth

(verb). bỏ đi

ideal

(noun). lý tưởng

This is such an ideal place for couples.

transit

fresh

(adjective). tươi

needs

preserve

perish

(verb). quyên sinh

Three hundred people perished in the earthquake.

export

(verb). Xuất khẩu

Iran exports goods to many countries.

preservation

(noun). sự bảo quản

shortage

(noun). sự thiếu

case

(noun). trường hợp

Ultra

(adverb). cực độ

method

(noun). phương pháp

treat

(verb). xử lý

tend

Written language tends to be formal.

sacrifice

canning

tin-plated

steel

container

cost-effective

poisoning

temperature

(noun). nhiệt độ

proper

(adjective). chính xác

refrigeration

(noun). sự đông lạnh

processing

time-consuming

chemical

(noun). nhiều

The center offers a variety of leisure activities.

list

(verb). danh sách

label

(noun). nhãn dán

preservative

(noun). chất bảo quản

ancient

civilization

jam

vinegar

Would you like oil and vinegar on your salad?

pickle

long-lasting

(adjective). lâu dài

store

nutrient

scientific

diagram

end

liquid

spread

layer

belt

form

material

powder

evaporate

blade

scrape

irradiation

(verb). Chiếu xạ

micro-organism

(noun). Vi sinh vật

pasteurisation

Tin

(noun). thiếc

climate

(noun). khí hậu

strip

(noun). dải, miếng
